arena: Classic Generic procedural_v2 11x9, two players, 2400-action horizon
method: Direct routed-v6 plays both seats through round7. At the first root-turn start in rounds8–24 with a different direct-versus-three-turn-teacher first action, fork the pre-turn state. Each policy completes one root turn on its respective branch; then direct routed-v6 controls both seats in BOTH branches to terminal or action limit. Teacher search is not used in the continuation.
interpretation: Moving the sampled first disagreement to rounds8–24 did not reveal positive terminal one-turn credit under direct-policy continuation. Together with the separate opening-heavy window, this argues against using isolated teacher-turn terminal labels as the next distillation target. The first eligible rounds still dominate (101/126 samples in rounds8–9), and persistent multi-turn teacher play remains a different policy whose independently validated strength is not challenged by this conditional test.

verification.resource_policy: SSH server fedora-toolbox, pinned single CPU, nice19, no GPU

decision: Stop further single-turn terminal-credit scaling on these windows. Investigate how persistent teacher plans depend on later teacher actions and how a student could represent that sequence; predeclare new disjoint data and full-game gates before training. No model, Elo rating, or playable bot changed.
